title: Pharmacological evaluation and formulation design of lavender volatile oil cream for the treatment of chronic prostatitis: Mechanistic insights into therapeutic efficacy.
authors: Wang, Jinhui; Li, Taotao; Ge, Xiaoxiao; Chen, Chao; Chen, Qin; Zhang, Shihao; Wang, Mengmeng; Liu, Mei; Niu, Zihao; Shi, Huanxian; Xie, Yundong; Shi, Yajun; Zou, Junbo; Guo, Dongyan; Sun, Jing; Zhang, Xiaofei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究薰衣草挥发油乳膏治疗慢性前列腺炎的制剂优化与抗炎机制，涉及分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study optimized the formulation of lavender volatile oil cream (LVOC) through single factor experiments and response surface methodology, and investigated the effects of emulsifiers, oil phase components, and moisturizers on the physical properties of the cream. The optimized formula contains 2.00 % lavender volatile oil, 6.00 % liquid paraffin, 7.57 % octadecanol, 10.00 % Vaseline, 4.89 % glycerol, and 1.34 % sodium dodecyl sulfate. The resulting cream has a uniform texture, good stability, and stable active ingredient content. Physical and chemical property analysis shows that the cream has a suitable particle size (680.40 nm) and low polydispersity coefficient (PDI) (0.15), a pH (5.97) that meets the standards for skin application, and excellent mechanical stability in rheological properties. In addition, retention experiments have confirmed that LVOC can significantly reduce the loss of volatile oil (p < 0.01). In the chronic prostatitis (CP) rat model, LVOC significantly reduced the inflammatory response by downregulating the expression of cyclooxygenase-2 (COX2), phosphorylated protein kinase B (p-AKT), phosphorylated nuclear factor kappa B p65 subunit (p-p65), and phosphorylated phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase (p-PI3K) proteins. Molecular docking analysis further revealed that the main active ingredients of LVOC, such as linalool and linalool acetate, may exert therapeutic effects through the PI3K-AKT/Nuclear Factor Kappa B (NF-kappaB) signaling pathway. This study provides a scientific basis for the development of LVOC formulations and verifies its potential application value in CP treatment.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过单因素实验和响应面法优化了薰衣草挥发油乳膏（LVOC）的配方，并考察了乳化剂、油相组分和保湿剂对乳膏物理性质的影响。优化后的配方包含2.00%薰衣草挥发油、6.00%液体石蜡、7.57%十八醇、10.00%凡士林、4.89%甘油和1.34%十二烷基硫酸钠。所得乳膏质地均匀，稳定性良好，活性成分含量稳定。理化性质分析表明，该乳膏具有适宜的粒径（680.40 nm）和低多分散系数（PDI）（0.15），pH值（5.97）符合皮肤应用标准，且在流变学性质中表现出优异的机械稳定性。此外，保留实验证实LVOC能显著减少挥发油的损失（p < 0.01）。在慢性前列腺炎（CP）大鼠模型中，LVOC通过下调环氧合酶-2（COX2）、磷酸化蛋白激酶B（p-AKT）、磷酸化核因子κB p65亚基（p-p65）和磷酸化磷脂酰肌醇3-激酶（p-PI3K）蛋白的表达，显著减轻了炎症反应。分子对接分析进一步揭示，LVOC的主要活性成分如芳樟醇和乙酸芳樟酯可能通过PI3K-AKT/核因子κB（NF-kappaB）信号通路发挥治疗作用。本研究为LVOC配方的开发提供了科学依据，并验证了其在CP治疗中的潜在应用价值。
